attributes.board_name: Oklahoma Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Only Board-approved activities (Board list of pre-approved activities; providers may seek pre-approval). 1 university semester hour = 15 clock hours; teaching approved programs = 3 clock hours per hour taught; publication up to 20 hours; job-required activities such as CPR once per period, max 20% of required hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensure during a period: prorated 2.5 clock hours per full three-month quarter remaining; if the prorated total is under 5 hours, the ethics requirement does not apply.
rules.audit_note: Audits every even year of at least 3% of licensees; audited licensees submit provider-signed verification within 30 days. Non-compliant licensees get 90 days to make up hours. A 90-day extension can be petitioned before Dec 31 for a $50 fee.

topics.who: All licensees and SLP assistants: professional ethics related to SLP/audiology (not required if the prorated first-period total is under 5 hours)

rules.notes: CE period runs Jan 1 of each odd year to Dec 31 of the following even year; the license fee is paid every year. The same rule applies to speech-language pathology assistants; audiology assistants are exempt from CE hours. SLPs who supervise clinical fellows or SLP assistants need a one-time 6 hours of Board-approved clinical supervision training (within 10 years before requesting approval to supervise; OAC 690:10-5-6, 690:10-7-3).
